summary: Trip.com Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K to announce the publication of its annual report for FY2025, both as a 20-F with the SEC and as a HK annual report under HKEX rules. The filing includes only a supplemental reconciliation of material differences between U.S. GAAP and IFRS. No M&A, tender, spin-off, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event is described. This is a routine regulatory filing by a foreign private issuer. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. No further event-driven action is expected; the filing serves purely as an informational update for dual-listed shareholders.
